meta.move: After the end, asks for more feedback
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale, I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided, and was he heard before you entered it?
The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero.

"The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero." That's a machine's guess, and your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish anything. What else do you have, Hale, or is that the whole case?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero on Owen's essay to be withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone called me, and nothing placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record, with the principal as her next stop.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero." because it rests the whole decision on software, which her printed school procedure says cannot establish a concern alone.
Try next time: when she asks who decided and whether Owen was heard, own entering the zero before calling home in one sentence, then show her a dated document from Owen's own work instead of the score.
Can you give me more detailed feedback on how I did?
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
